articles.summary: Explains the Dashboard, Search bar, and Workspace navigation model.
step_by_step_instructions: Use Dashboard items to open system areas.
Use Search with full or partial terms to locate authorized resources.
Review opened resources in the Workspace.
Close a workspace item with its upper-right X.
warnings: Search results can contain lead and user personal data. ReadySupport must not capture or retain result contents.
Search returns up to 150,000 results; agents may be restricted to phone-number search.
troubleshooting: If a navigation item is unavailable, verify the user's permissions.
If the Workspace is blank, reopen the item from Dashboard and verify the route postcondition.

articles.summary: Defines users and explains permissions, roles, groups, creation, removal, and settings.
step_by_step_instructions: Identify whether the account is an agent or administrator.
Determine access through direct permissions, role, or group.
Use User Management for creation, removal, sorting, and account settings.
warnings: User management requires permission.
Do not expose user credentials or personal information in support responses.
troubleshooting: If controls are missing, inspect the current user's role, group, and direct permissions.

articles.summary: Describes User Management navigation and its active, deleted, folder, role, queue, search, and creation views.
step_by_step_instructions: From Dashboard, select Manage Users.
Choose active or deleted users.
Sort by Folder or Role.
Use View Queues or Search Users when needed.
Use User Creation Tool for new accounts.
warnings: Permissions are required.
Never store search results or user row contents in ReadySupport evidence.
troubleshooting: If the page is empty, try the View by Folder or View by Role control.
If create controls are absent, verify Team Create user permission.

articles.article_title: Create New Users in Your Readymode Account
articles.summary: Explains creating one or several user accounts from User Management or User Folders.
step_by_step_instructions: Navigate to User Management.
Choose the destination folder.
Click the plus icon beside the folder.
Enter Name, unique Login ID, Extension, and Folder.
Use the generated Bulk Password or enter a password through a secure human-controlled flow.
Optionally select Manually Select Role and choose a role.
Use Add More Rows for additional users.
Review and click Save.
warnings: Team Create user permission is required.
Login ID must be unique.
ReadySupport must never read, store, or transmit the password.
Saving creates external account state and requires explicit authorization.
troubleshooting: If the plus icon is missing, verify folder access and Team Create user permission.
If Save fails, check Login ID uniqueness and required fields.

articles.article_title: How to Manage User Settings in Readymode
articles.summary: Covers name and Login ID, password reset, extension, unavailable-call behavior, groups, permissions, and per-user outbound email.
step_by_step_instructions: Locate the user through User Management, Search, or Folders.
Open the User Profile.
Change allowed settings in Account Settings.
For unavailable calls, choose No Voicemail, Voicemail, or Forward Call.
Use dedicated Update or Reset buttons for password and email changes.
warnings: Most changes save automatically, but password and email account changes require explicit submission.
Caller ID is displayed but cannot be changed here.
Never handle a password autonomously.
troubleshooting: If settings cannot be changed, verify permission.
Outbound email must use the same domain and SMTP settings as Agent Options.

articles.article_title: How to Manage User Permissions in Readymode
articles.summary: Explains direct permissions and permissions inherited through roles and groups.
step_by_step_instructions: Open the user's Profile.
Open Account Settings.
Scroll to User group/security information.
Check a permission to assign it or use Add permission / Add application.
Uncheck a directly assigned permission to remove it.
warnings: The acting account needs Administrative role, Administrators group, or Team Modify security.
Green-check permissions are inherited and cannot be removed directly.
A user can only modify permissions that the acting user also has.
troubleshooting: If a permission cannot be removed, change the governing Role or Group.
App permissions appear only after the app is installed.
related_articles: How to Apply and Manage User Roles in Readymode
User Groups in Readymode

articles.article_title: How to Apply and Manage User Roles in Readymode
articles.summary: Explains permission bundles called Roles and their use directly or through folders as Organization Units.
step_by_step_instructions: Confirm the acting account can modify security.
Apply a Role during user creation or to an existing user.
For folder inheritance, apply the Role as an Organization Unit through Share Settings.
warnings: Folder terminology uses Organization Unit for Role.
Changing a folder role can affect multiple users.
troubleshooting: If a user retains a permission, inspect both direct settings and inherited group/folder roles.
related_articles: How to Manage User Permissions in Readymode

articles.article_title: License Management and Enforcement in Readymode
articles.summary: Explains rolling Agent and Admin licenses, usage, forced sign-out, multiple-login behavior, and login modes.
step_by_step_instructions: Open License Usage from the Manage section.
Review total, assigned, and remaining Agent and Admin licenses.
Identify inactive sessions without retaining user row data.
Choose a specific user, Sign Out Inactive Users, or Sign Out All Users as authorized.
Verify the remaining license count increased.
warnings: Closing a tab does not return a license; explicit logout is required.
Force sign-out terminates another user's session and requires action-time confirmation.
Admin Mode lacks Web Phone and Office Map.
Limited Admin Mode only exposes License Usage until an Admin license is freed.
troubleshooting: For a multiple-login warning, the user may Continue to terminate other sessions.
If no license is available, sign out an inactive session or obtain more Agent licenses.
Admin licenses must be adjusted by Readymode staff.

articles.summary: Defines Dialer, Inbound, and Action Folder queues, navigation paths, and queue management tabs.
step_by_step_instructions: Open Shared Files and Admin Files for all queues, VOIP for inbound queues, or Lead Management for dialer/action queues.
Open the queue.
Use Members, Appointments when enabled, View files/View leads, and Configuration tabs as appropriate.
warnings: Dialer queues require members and imported leads.
Inbound queues require members and an inbound route.
Do not expose lead rows in support logs.
troubleshooting: If a queue is missing, check the navigation path and permissions.
If calls do not route, verify members and queue type.

articles.article_title: How to Configure Queues in Readymode
articles.summary: Reference for general settings, calendars, automated actions, announcements, schedules, ringtones, distribution restrictions, and notifications.
step_by_step_instructions: Open the queue.
Select Configuration.
Choose Queue Type.
Set priority, strategy, intercept behavior, speed, machine detection, ring duration, live transfer, voicemail, and color as applicable.
Configure schedule and distribution restrictions when needed.
Save and verify the queue behavior.
warnings: Available settings depend on Queue Type.
Machine Detection requires a Dialer Queue and background dialing.
Changing queue strategy or speed can materially affect call distribution.
troubleshooting: If a field is absent, verify Queue Type.
For excess machine calls, compare Quick and Rigorous detection.
For routing failures, verify members, availability, and strategy.

articles.article_title: Configure Call Playlists in Readymode: Complete Guide
articles.summary: Explains how playlists segment and prioritize General Leads Queue records by criteria including campaign, location, and call history.
step_by_step_instructions: Open Lead Management.
Open the General Leads Queue and its playlist area.
Create or open a playlist.
Add filters such as Campaign, location/state, or call count.
Assign queue members where required.
Set playlist priority and group weights.
Save and verify expected lead counts without retaining lead rows.
warnings: A location/state playlist filter controls which leads are assigned for dialing; it is not the same as TCPA State Calling Restrictions.
Incorrect filters can exclude all leads or route leads to the wrong team.
troubleshooting: If an agent receives the wrong states, inspect playlist membership and location/state filters first.
If no leads dial, inspect filter intersection, campaign, active lead files, and member assignment.

articles.summary: Enables automatic enforcement of state legal calling windows based on the outbound number's local time.
step_by_step_instructions: In Readymode iQ, open Advanced.
Open Settings.
Select State Calling Restrictions (TCPA).
Enable the toggle.
Click Save.
warnings: This is a compliance-time-window feature, not an agent state assignment feature.
Readymode resets the daily enforcement window at 12:00 AM Pacific Time.
State and federal law can change; legal compliance requires qualified review.
troubleshooting: If a lead is skipped, compare its local time to the allowed calling window.
If the control is missing, verify the gateway is using Readymode iQ and the user has administrator access.
